lines.title: The Fifty Year Signature

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Sit down, both of you. It's getting cold.
lines.why: 'a warm happy moment at the table' (7/19). ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the most ordinary sentence in the world, on purpose -- the cut has to take something SMALL and real, not a speech. 'Both of you' quietly establishes two siblings before one of them is gone. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: THE BLINDSIDE (mundane -> devastating)
cites.applied: the corpus is explicit that the setup's LIGHTNESS is what makes the drop land, so the opening line of the game is deliberately the least remarkable sentence in the house. A portentous first line spends the match-cut before the match-cut happens.

cites.title: THE HOUSE'S INTERIOR IS ONE ROOM DEEP
cites.applied: that study's named failure is a siege-home with no domestic texture, where 'the family exists in two character models and a closet'. Food going cold and a mother counting heads IS the domestic texture, bought in one sentence before the same house gets besieged.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: sibling_lost
lines.text: I'm not eating the green ones.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the sibling who is taken on night one gets one line, and it is a child being a child about vegetables. Nothing portentous. The whole weight of this scene depends on her being unremarkable here. WHICH sibling is lost is HIS ruling (7/19 leaning) -- this speaks whoever the surface casts. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: ATTACHMENT FROM MUNDANE INTIMACY
cites.applied: the only bond the player will ever get with this sibling has to form in one line, and the corpus says the bond forms through quiet ordinary emotionally-available moments, the everyday IS the attachment, not melodrama. So she gets vegetables, not a goodbye.

cites.title: FORESHADOW-IN-HINDSIGHT
cites.applied: a line that only lands LATER, so the scene plays differently in memory than in the moment. Petty refusal of a vegetable is the last ordinary thing she says, and the player only learns that afterwards, which is the entire mechanism that study describes.

cites.title: THE HOUSE'S INTERIOR IS ONE ROOM DEEP
cites.applied: 'no child's drawings' is one of the three absences that study names by hand. This is the child's drawing, in audio, and it costs six words.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: father
lines.text: They're saying the water district's hiring again. I'll go down Monday.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule). PAOLO 8/11 ON v1: "it was short". The pre-collapse half was two lines long, so the warmth had no time to become a place. This is the father whole, ten years before he is the man in the dark: a guy with a Monday and a job to go ask about. It also puts the ECONOMY in the first thirty seconds without a word of exposition, which is the game's own subject. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: TRANSACTION-CARRIES-EMOTION
cites.applied: the corpus is blunt about it: do not open with 'here's a sad story', open with the errand and let the weight sneak in under it. The first thing this family talks about is WORK, which is the instrumental frame, and every ounce of grief the scene later earns arrives underneath it.

cites.title: CARTOONY SURFACE, REAL DRAMA UNDER
cites.applied: a warm surface makes the drama land HARDER. A man cheerful about a hiring notice is the warmest thing in the scene and it is thirty seconds from being the last normal Monday anybody in this room gets.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: sibling_older
lines.text: Can I take the truck Saturday? I'll put gas in it, I swear.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the older sibling gets a line BEFORE the cut so the voice that speaks after it is one you have already heard, which is the only reason the after-line lands. A teenager negotiating for the car is the most ordinary sentence a teenager has ever said. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: AMBIENT BANTER AS CHARACTERIZATION
cites.applied: the corpus calls overheard, ordinary talk the cheapest and highest-impact characterisation there is, and names it solo-dev gold. Nobody in this exchange is telling the player anything; they are just a family at a table, and that is what makes them one.

cites.title: W4 (fair-play seeding — MANDATORY
cites.applied: seed relentlessly from the start so the later beat is inevitable-in-hindsight. He asks for the truck and gas; both of those become currency in about ten years, and neither is remarked on here.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: sibling_older
lines.text: Same chair. Ten years and you still take the same chair.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the first line after the cut has to make the audience LOOK at the table again and understand what happened without narration. It also names the empty seat without naming it. Sits on the [PENDING] EMPTY CHAIR motif seed WITHOUT building it. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: THE MUNDANE HOOK -> COSMIC DREAD
cites.applied: the ordinary frame makes the reveal land harder. The first thing said after ten years of apocalypse is about SEATING, so the player's own eye does the reveal instead of a narrator doing it for them.

cites.title: EXPOSITION-HEAVY / LORE-DUMP LATE
cites.applied: that study's failure is unloading the world's truth in big talky chunks, and its lesson is DRIP-FEED. The collapse therefore gets zero words here. The line points at the furniture and lets the player count the chairs.

cites.title: THE HAUNTED SPACE
cites.applied: the shack tells its story environmentally without exposition. Here the TABLE is the haunted space: same frame, same seats, one of them empty, and nobody explains it.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: father
lines.text: Up. Now. Don't turn the light on.
lines.why: 'Your FATHER wakes you: bandits/raiders are attacking the home.' ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): low and flat, not shouted -- a man who has thought about this night before it came. The third sentence does the work: it tells you they are close enough to see a window, without a word of exposition. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: NODE SURVIVOR_COMFORT
cites.applied: that node's banked rule is REMOVE THE ALIBI VERB: the game withholds the sentence that would let the pressure out. The father is given no comfort verb. He does not say it will be okay and he does not explain what is outside, because either one is a pressure valve on the scene the tutorial is about to be.

cites.title: DREAD, NOT JUMPSCARES
cites.applied: glimpse, withhold, imply, never show the monster. The raiders are not named, counted, or described. 'Don't turn the light on' tells you they are close enough to see a window, and that is the only fact the player gets.

cites.title: W7 (one crystallizing line
cites.applied: the ports master asks for ONE line that crystallizes the theme and implicates. Seven words set every rule of the night: move now, obey, and light is what kills you. The rest of Act 1 runs on those three.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: father
lines.text: Back door. Behind me, and don't run until I say run.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule). PAOLO 8/11 ON v1: "it was short". The father had one line and then the scene ended, so the tutorial arrived from nowhere. This is the second half of the same breath: it hands the player the shape of the fight before the fight, which is what a tutorial's first line is for. Still no explanation and still no comfort. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: ROLE-ASSIGNMENT AS CHARACTER-KNOWLEDGE
cites.applied: competence-casting: a man who knows his people puts each one where they belong. He assigns a door, an order of march and a trigger word in eleven words, which tells you he has thought about this night before it came without one line of him saying so.

cites.title: NODE SURVIVOR_COMFORT
cites.applied: REMOVE THE ALIBI VERB, held for a second line. The easiest sentence to write here is a reassurance, and the corpus's whole finding is that the reassurance is a pressure valve. He gives instructions instead, and the player is never told it will be alright because nobody in the room knows that.

lines.title: THE MATCH-CUT OPEN

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Eat. It's the last of the good stuff and it doesn't keep.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule). The scene does NOT open on grief. It opens on a mother telling her family to eat, which is the only thing she can still do for them, and the grief arrives underneath it three lines later. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: TRANSACTION-CARRIES-EMOTION
cites.applied: the corpus is blunt: do not open with 'here's a sad story', open with the errand and let the weight sneak in under the instrumental frame. So the first line of the grief dinner is about FOOD SPOILING, and every sad thing after it lands on a table somebody was trying to be practical at.

cites.title: THE HOUSE'S INTERIOR IS ONE ROOM DEEP
cites.applied: that study's failure is a family home with no domestic texture. 'The last of the good stuff' is a pantry, a week's planning and a household economy in seven words, on the day none of it matters.

lines.title: THE GRIEF DINNER

lines.speaker: sibling_older
lines.text: I hate this.
lines.why: *** PAOLO'S OWN LINE. draft:false — NO LANE MAY EDIT THIS. *** He wrote it into the 7/19 addendum himself as one of the two lines that define this beat. Three words, no object, no explanation of what 'this' is, which is exactly how somebody talks the day after.
lines.title: THE GRIEF DINNER

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: I miss them so much, I can't.
lines.why: *** PAOLO'S OWN LINE. draft:false — NO LANE MAY EDIT THIS. *** The sentence breaks in the middle and never finishes, which is the whole reason it works. 'Bohemia commits to grief most games flinch from' (7/19) is this line.
lines.title: THE GRIEF DINNER

lines.speaker: sibling_older
lines.text: I know. Don't say it back to me, I know.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the answer to his mother is NOT comfort. He stops her from being comforted at him, which is a real thing people do the day after and is the opposite of what a game usually writes here. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: NODE SURVIVOR_COMFORT
cites.applied: that node's banked rule is REMOVE THE ALIBI VERB — the game withholds the sentence that would let the pressure out. Here the CHARACTER removes it himself, out loud, which does the same job and tells you who he is becoming in one line.

cites.title: THE ATTENTIVE UNEARTH THE GRIEF
cites.applied: the corpus rewards the player who digs into long-buried loss rather than being handed it. Nobody in this scene explains the loss to the player; it is already in the room, and the writing's whole job is to not narrate it.

lines.title: THE GRIEF DINNER

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: We go up in the morning. Wear something you don't mind ruining.
lines.why: ATTEMPT (8/11 rule): the scene ends by pointing at beat 3 (THE BURIAL ON THE RIDGE, 7/19) without doing it, and it points with a LOGISTICAL instruction rather than a sad one — clothes you can dig in. Deliberately does not say who walks up, because that is his ruling. EDIT FREELY.

cites.title: PEREGRINATION (duration AS emotion)
cites.applied: the corpus banks duration itself as an emotional instrument — the botchling carry is slow ON PURPOSE. This line's job is to promise the walk, so the burial's climb up the ridge arrives already weighted rather than starting cold.

cites.title: W9 (regret as the answer / change costs
cites.applied: the spine banked from Planescape is regret borne rather than undone. The last thing said at this table is a plan for the morning: the family carries it and keeps moving, which is the only answer the game is ever going to give.
